boundary: Clean-room capability convergence. Do not copy MasterMNG source, branding, private APIs, assets, schemas or visual design. Project Desk remains authoritative for work and decisions; existing Agent Work OS sessions remain authoritative for execution.
goldenPaths: human configures a valid company hierarchy and cycles fail closed
agent owns work and submits evidence-backed completion
material decision carries reason, options, risk, policy and evidence references
human resolves the decision exactly once and replay is refused
President Overview reflects authoritative work, decision and run state
audit export binds company/work/decision/activity/run receipts with a deterministic digest
browser command center renders mobile-responsive overview, structure, live agents and Decision Desk

negative: agent cannot resolve a human decision
approved multi-option decision requires an exact selected option

deployment.artifact: existing Agent Work OS Docker image
deployment.localRuntime: npm run start:api plus local daemon
deployment.hostedControlPlane: requires a durable Node/WebSocket host; do not represent a static-only deployment as the full product
deployment.credentials: provider and repository credentials stay on the developer-owned local daemon

completionRule: Do not claim SHIPPED from implementation alone. Exact-head CI, existing acceptance suite, Docker build, browser UAT, deployment/recovery and exact-SHA evidence are separate gates.
